params.message:
Assign a bid through day 21, greet a garage by its name, purchase price in the bought mail

The assignment window was already day 8 through day 21; the code counted it as
fifteen days from the end date and the late-assignment message said "15 days
after the end date". ASSIGN_DAYS names the fourteen, the message and the
insights note say fourteen, and a test pins the day 21 boundary. A mail to the
general address of a garage that no user signs in with now greets the garage
by its name instead of a bare "Dag,". The bought mail labels the buyer's price
"Aankoopprijs". The Hexon import notes that Mercedes-AMG stays under
Mercedes-Benz. The four decisions are recorded and finding X-19 is closed.

Portal: Toewijzen tot en met dag 21 bevestigd, mails naar het algemene adres van een garage noemen de garage, en de gekocht-mail spreekt van aankoopprijs.
